Job Description SAP RAR Consultant

Position: SAP RAR Consultant
Experience: 3–8 Years
Location: Chennai (Work from Office )
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) Consultant with 4–8 years of SAP implementation and support experience. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SAP RAR, revenue recognition processes, and integration with SAP SD, FI, BRIM, and S/4HANA. The consultant will be responsible for delivering end-to-end RAR solutions, including implementation, configuration, enhancements, testing, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and implement SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) solutions.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP RAR solutions.
  • Configure Revenue Accounting Contracts (RAC), Performance Obligations (POB), Revenue Contracts, and Revenue Recognition processes.
  • Work on end-to-end implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
  • Integrate SAP RAR with SAP SD, FI/CO, BRIM (CI, CC, SOM), and SAP S/4HANA modules.
  • Configure Revenue Accounting Items (RAI), POB determination, contract modifications, and revenue postings.
  • Support month-end and year-end revenue recognition activities.
  • Perform functional testing, integration testing, UAT, and production issue resolution.
  • Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP developers for custom developments.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and resolve production issues within defined SLAs.
  • Develop functional documentation, configuration guides, and user training materials.
  • Collaborate with business users and cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

  • 3–8 years of SAP functional consulting experience.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
  • Strong knowledge of revenue recognition principles and IFRS 15 / ASC 606 compliance.
  • Experience in SAP RAR configuration and business process design.
  • Hands-on experience with Revenue Accounting Items (RAI), Revenue Accounting Contracts (RAC), Performance Obligations (POB), Contract Modifications, and Revenue Posting.
  • Strong integration knowledge with SAP SD, FI/CO, and SAP BRIM.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA RAR implementations or migration projects.
  • Ability to prepare Functional Specifications (FS) and work closely with technical teams.
  • Experience in production support, enhancements, and incident management.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in SAP BRIM environments (Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, Subscription Order Management).
  • Knowledge of SAP FICA and Revenue Management processes.
  • Experience with interfaces using IDocs, APIs, or middleware platforms.
  • SAP RAR or SAP S/4HANA certification is an added advantage.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum project methodologies.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills.
  • Willingness to work on implementation, support, and enhancement engagements.

Job Purpose

To develop, manage, and execute Information Security Governance, Risk and Compliance across Mashreq to

  • Contribute strategically to the bank s success and enable the business and technology strategy of the bank to expand with secure and reliable service offering.

  • Navigate compliance complexities and support compliance with information security requirements across regions,

  • Ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our sensitive information and IT assets and a proactive approach to build a resilient security posture and

  • Empower a security-conscious culture - all while.

Manager IS Governance, Risk and Compliance (IS GRC) has overall responsibility for information security governance, risk and compliance management and supporting Head of IS GRC to achieve organization s security strategy and goals. He / She is deputy of the Head of IS GRC.

Manager of IS GRC is a T-Shaped expert with proven skills in most core capability areas of IS GRC: Policy, Governance and Culture, Cyber Strategy & Program Management and Risk and Compliance. She / He will actively develop his expertise and leadership in other capability area to cover all GCR scope, including by rotating roles between Managers of IS GRC.

Manager of IS GRC will lead a Center of Excellence in his area of primary focus and supports the growth of T-Shaped expertise in the CoE.

Performance evaluation of the role will be based on the positive impact on the bank in terms of risk reduction instead on the effort put in place.

Key Result Areas

  • Risk Life-Cycle Management:

    • Define risk lifecycle management process for the bank in alignment with ERM and ORM and enable the same in ISG GRC solution to support the unit.

    Job Description SAP RAR Consultant

    Position: SAP RAR Consultant
    Experience: 3–8 Years
    Location: Chennai (Work from Office )
    Employment Type: Full-Time

    Job Summary

    We are looking for an experienced SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) Consultant with 4–8 years of SAP implementation and support experience. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SAP RAR, revenue recognition processes, and integration with SAP SD, FI, BRIM, and S/4HANA. The consultant will be responsible for delivering end-to-end RAR solutions, including implementation, configuration, enhancements, testing, and production support.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Design, configure, and implement SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) solutions.
    • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP RAR solutions.
    • Configure Revenue Accounting Contracts (RAC), Performance Obligations (POB), Revenue Contracts, and Revenue Recognition processes.
    • Work on end-to-end implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
    • Integrate SAP RAR with SAP SD, FI/CO, BRIM (CI, CC, SOM), and SAP S/4HANA modules.
    • Configure Revenue Accounting Items (RAI), POB determination, contract modifications, and revenue postings.
    • Support month-end and year-end revenue recognition activities.
    • Perform functional testing, integration testing, UAT, and production issue resolution.
    • Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP developers for custom developments.
    • Conduct root cause analysis and resolve production issues within defined SLAs.
    • Develop functional documentation, configuration guides, and user training materials.
    • Collaborate with business users and cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.

    Required Skills

    • 3–8 years of SAP functional consulting experience.
    • Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
    • Strong knowledge of revenue recognition principles and IFRS 15 / ASC 606 compliance.
    • Experience in SAP RAR configuration and business process design.
    • Hands-on experience with Revenue Accounting Items (RAI), Revenue Accounting Contracts (RAC), Performance Obligations (POB), Contract Modifications, and Revenue Posting.
    • Strong integration knowledge with SAP SD, FI/CO, and SAP BRIM.
    • Experience with SAP S/4HANA RAR implementations or migration projects.
    • Ability to prepare Functional Specifications (FS) and work closely with technical teams.
    • Experience in production support, enhancements, and incident management.
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

    Preferred Skills

    • Experience in SAP BRIM environments (Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, Subscription Order Management).
    • Knowledge of SAP FICA and Revenue Management processes.
    • Experience with interfaces using IDocs, APIs, or middleware platforms.
    • SAP RAR or SAP S/4HANA certification is an added advantage.
    • Exposure to Agile/Scrum project methodologies.

    Educational Qualification

    • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, or a related discipline.

    Soft Skills

    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

    Job Title: SAP Group Reporting Consultant
    Experience: 3 - 8 Years
    Location: Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune / Mumbai / Kolkata / Chennai / Gurgaon
    Work Mode: Hybrid
    Shift Timings: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
    Interview Process: 2 Technical Rounds
    Level: Consultant (Individual Contributor)

    Job Summary

    We are looking for experienced SAP Group Reporting Consultants with 3–8 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting and financial consolidation processes. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in configuring and supporting SAP Group Reporting functionalities, including master data setup and mapping, Data Monitor, Consolidation Monitor, historical data migration, currency translation, intercompany eliminations, consolidation of investments, data aggregation, and reporting rules.

    The role involves implementing, configuring, and supporting SAP Group Reporting solutions, analyzing consolidation requirements, troubleshooting functional issues, supporting data migration and testing activities, and collaborating with finance and technical teams to deliver accurate and efficient financial consolidation solutions.

    Key Responsibilities

    SAP Group Reporting

    Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting functionalities.
    Perform master data setup, maintenance, and mapping for group reporting requirements.
    Configure and support the Data Monitor and Consolidation Monitor.
    Support data collection, validation, and consolidation activities.
    Configure and maintain consolidation processes based on business requirements.
    Support financial consolidation and group reporting processes.

    Master Data Setup & Mapping

    Configure and maintain relevant master data for Group Reporting.
    Define and maintain mappings between source systems and Group Reporting.
    Support mapping of organizational units, accounts, entities, and other consolidation-relevant master data.
    Analyze and resolve master data and mapping-related issues.

    Historical Data Migration

    Support historical data migration into the SAP Group Reporting environment.
    Analyze legacy data and define appropriate migration and mapping requirements.
    Validate migrated historical data for accuracy and completeness.
    Support reconciliation between legacy systems and SAP Group Reporting.

    Currency Translation

    Configure and support currency translation processes.
    Define and maintain currency translation rules based on business requirements.
    Support foreign currency translation during consolidation.
    Analyze and resolve currency translation-related issues.

    Intercompany (IC) Elimination

    Configure and support intercompany elimination processes.
    Analyze intercompany differences and elimination requirements.
    Support reconciliation of intercompany balances and transactions.
    Troubleshoot issues related to intercompany matching and elimination.

    Consolidation of Investments

    Support the configuration and execution of consolidation of investment processes.
    Work with finance and consolidation teams to understand investment consolidation requirements.
    Support the analysis and resolution of investment consolidation-related issues.
    Ensure accurate consolidation results as per business requirements.

    Data Aggregation & Release Processes

    Support aggregation of financial data during the release process.
    Configure and validate data release and consolidation activities.
    Monitor data processing and identify inconsistencies or errors.
    Ensure accurate data flow from source systems into consolidation processes.

    Reporting Rules & Consolidation Reporting

    Configure and maintain reporting rules based on business requirements.
    Support consolidation reporting and financial reporting requirements.
    Analyze reporting requirements and translate them into functional configurations.
    Validate consolidated data and reporting outputs.

    Configuration & Testing

    Perform functional configuration in SAP Group Reporting.
    Conduct unit testing, integration testing, SIT, UAT, and regression testing.
    Prepare test scenarios and test scripts based on business requirements.
    Validate system functionality after configuration changes and enhancements.
    Support defect analysis, resolution, and retesting.

    Production Support & Issue Resolution

    Provide functional support for SAP Group Reporting production issues.
    Analyze and resolve issues related to consolidation, data collection, master data, mappings, currency translation, and eliminations.
    Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend permanent solutions.
    Resolve issues within agreed SLA timelines.
    Support month-end and year-end financial consolidation activities.

    Change & Enhancement Management

    Analyze business requirements and enhancement requests.
    Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing consolidation processes.
    Coordinate configuration, testing, and deployment activities.
    Maintain change logs, functional specifications, and related documentation.

    Documentation

    Prepare and maintain:
    o Functional Design Documents (FDD)
    o Configuration Documents
    o Business Process Documents
    o Test Scripts and Test Results
    o User Guides
    o Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
    o Knowledge Articles
    o Issue and Solution Documentation

    Stakeholder Collaboration

    Work closely with:
    o Finance and Controlling Teams
    o Corporate Consolidation Teams
    o Business Users
    o SAP Technical Teams
    o Project Managers
    o Integration and Data Migration Teams

    Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and process discussions.
    Understand business consolidation requirements and provide functional solutions.
    Support user training and knowledge transfer activities.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of SAP Group Reporting solutions.
